top_signals.title: Severe Thunderstorms Across US Midwest Trigger Flood Warnings
top_signals.summary: The US Midwest and Ohio Valley, including Chicago and Cincinnati, face an enhanced, or level 3, risk of severe thunderstorms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Pakistan signals progress on U.S.-Iran deal as Washington and Tehran trade reparation demands
top_signals.summary: The dueling positions Washington and Tehran staked out showed how far apart the two sides remain even as both talked of winding down regional hostilities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia unveils first open-source AI model since CEO Jensen Huang entered the chat
top_signals.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is free for companies to download, use and modify without getting permission or paying Nvidia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ‘Clear scale up path’: Bernstein sees 80% upside for Riot after reported $9.1 billion Anthropic deal
top_signals.summary: The firm's analysts estimate AI colocation now accounts for 84% of Riot's target enterprise value, versus 11% for bitcoin mining.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20 billion at $95 per share as AI demand accelerates
top_signals.summary: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: India’s Small Traders Lose $9.6 Billion in Options Despite Curbs
top_signals.summary: Individuals in India lost 916.85 billion rupees ($9.6 billion) buying and selling equity futures and options in the year ended March, down from 1.1 trillion rupees a year earlier, the government told lawmakers on Tuesday.

top_signals.title: Vague Task, Total Access: When AI Delegation Becomes a Security Risk
top_signals.summary: AI agents can improvise beyond the intended scope of a task when they are given broad access to enterprise systems and data. Token Security explains why organizations need to define agent intent and continuously enforce permissions around what each agent was actually created to do. [...]

top_signals.title: Local governments in four states dealing with cyberattacks that have shut down services
top_signals.summary: Municipalities in California, Oklahoma, Wisconsin and Texas are all recovering from disruptive cyberattacks that have affected government operations.
